description: This Java class 'LogDownloader' provides a user interface component for uploading and managing log files from an ECU (Electronic Control Unit). It features UI elements to list available log files, delete files, download files, and refresh the list by communicating with the ECU through command messages.

classes.name: LogDownloader
classes.description: A Swing-based UI component that lists log files from an ECU, allowing users to delete or download logs, with automatic refresh handling.

methods.name: LogDownloader
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components, setting up message listener, and starting periodic directory listing.

methods.name: createFilePanel
methods.description: Creates a panel representing a log file with options to delete or download.

methods.name: resetLogsList
methods.description: Clears the current list of log files displayed.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of this UI component.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Prepares and displays the content panel, adding a refresh button.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Sends a command to list log files from the ECU.
